_source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35, consolidated text CELEX 02015R0035-20241114 (as in force from 14.11.2024) — Annex IX (risk zones), Annex X (zone risk weights), Annex XXII (windstorm), XXIII (earthquake), XXIV (flood), XXV (hail), XXVI (subsidence) zone correlation.
_citation: Del. Reg. (EU) 2015/35, Arts. 121-122 + Annexes IX, X, XXII-XXVI (consolidated 02015R0035-20241114)
_note: Country-agnostic exact-zonal tables for EVERY zoned region of Annexes V-VIII (+ FR subsidence). Each region under a peril carries its Annex IX zones (name + Annex X risk weight W) and the Annex XXII-XXVI zone-correlation matrix, keyed by zone id (dict-of-dicts — zone ids need not be contiguous). Keys: postal-code regions keyed by Annex IX code (leading zeros dropped, letters kept); administrative-unit regions (BG, CR, HU, RO) and multi-postcode-zone regions (FI, DK, SI) keyed by Annex IX zone number. Where a matrix is labelled by zone number it is re-keyed via Annex IX. Single-zone regions (Annex IX: LU, MT, Guadeloupe, Martinique, St Martin, Reunion) and IS carry no zone table; Andorra/Liechtenstein/Monaco/San Marino/Vatican map to FR 9 / CH 19 / FR 06 / IT 47 / IT 00. Extracted programmatically from the EU consolidated HTML (02015R0035-20241114): 3115 zones, 240711 correlation cells. Validated: complete weights, square n_zones x n_zones, symmetric, unit diagonal, weight-zone set == matrix-zone set. Region-level caveats in each region's source_note. labels_verified: false where the region's zone-label -> Annex IX mapping was inferred (see its source_note), true where it is read directly from Annex IX / the matrix labels.

PT.source_note: No Annex IX code table for PT; Annex X weight index k mapped to the k-th ascending postcode label of the Annex XXIII matrix (same ordering rule that holds for IT). Verified: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/269 adds a PT column to the Annex IX postal-code table; for all 79 zones its zone-k code equals the k-th ascending matrix label used here, and every Annex X weight matches index k.
